title: VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at Angul Smelter Plant
scope_summary: Development and commissioning of a Virtual Reality (VR) Training Module for Pot Room Activities at NALCO's Angul Smelter Plant to enhance industrial safety training through immersive simulations. This includes AR/VR-based simulations, SOP-based learning, PTM simulator operations, hazard identification, emergency workflows, and performance analytics.

title: Purchase of IIOT Laboratory Platforms
scope_summary: Procurement of IIoT Laboratory Platforms for Dr. B.R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar. The tender is for the supply of goods related to laboratory and scientific equipment for research purposes.

title: 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRs
scope_summary: Procurement of a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Quality Requirements for the Indian Army. The tender specifies the acquisition of a single unit and adherence to MHA QRs (Q3).

title: AI Studio Procurement for National Institute of Technology Digital Twin Research
scope_summary: Procurement of an AI Studio specifically designed for Digital Twin Applications for research and development within the National Institute of Technology. This tender is issued under the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education.

title: AI/ML as a Service for Engineering/Process Digital Twin Development
scope_summary: Oil India Limited invites proposals for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning as a Service for the development and implementation of an Engineering/Process Digital Twin across multiple sites (Makum OCS, Hebeda GCS, Madhuban CGGS, and OTP). The tender seeks end-to-end AI/ML services, design, development, deployment, and ongoing support for a scalable digital twin.

title: Contract For Implementation Of Ai-Based Predictive Maintenance And Asset Management Solution For Stage-1 Tdbfp Auxiliary Oil Pumps
scope_summary: Tender for the implementation of an AI-based predictive maintenance and asset management solution for Stage-1 TDBFP Auxiliary Oil Pumps. This aims to enhance the reliability and efficiency of critical power plant equipment.

title: Supply of Asset Performance Management System (APMS)
scope_summary: Tender for the supply of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS), including design, engineering, manufacturing, procurement of materials, assembly, inspection, testing, packing, and training for owner engineers.

title: Procurement of Advanced Diagnostic Tool For Predictive Maintenance Of Various Transmission Lines Under Kumaon Zone, Haldwani And Garhwal Zone, Roorkee
scope_summary: Tender for the procurement of an advanced diagnostic tool for predictive maintenance of transmission lines in the Kumaon Zone (Haldwani) and Garhwal Zone (Roorkee). The system should provide real-time equipment health monitoring, alerts, analytics, and support predictive maintenance with IT/OT cybersecurity.
